The process for VPN access is documented in the IT knowledge base article titled "VPN Access" (KB article ID: IT-KB-108), last updated on 2026-06-20. The article covers symptoms, first-line troubleshooting steps, required ticket fields, and escalation procedures. It states that remote employees must use the company VPN when working on customer or source-code data over public Wi-Fi, and that MFA is required on every login per the Security and MFA Policy. The article also notes that outdated guidance about shared VPN passwords is invalid​​[documents/it_kb/vpn_access.md § (whole document)].

Additionally, the Remote Work Policy (effective 2026-06-01) emphasizes that working remotely does not relax security requirements. It requires remote employees to use MFA on every login, maintain WPA2/WPA3 home Wi-Fi with a non-default password, and avoid working on sensitive data over public Wi-Fi without the company VPN. Managed laptop disk encryption and screen lock must remain enabled​​[documents/policies/remote_work_policy.md § (whole document)].
